_source: Installed-RTD-derived (S32K3 RTD 7.0.1 Uart.xdm / Platform.xdm / .epd), S32K344 IRQ header (S32K344_IRQ.h from SDK), fixture Uart_Example_S32K344 (committed: tests/fixtures/nxp/ds/s32k3/Uart_Example_S32K344). Uart.xdm is not committed in this repo; all field/enum values are fixture-verified and pinned by test_uart_apply.py::TestUartAsset and test_uart_flexio_add_channel.py::TestUartAssetFlexioEnums (LL-012, LL-012b).

_coverage._note: Honest map of the Uart editable surface this CLI exposes today vs. the Uart.xdm items NOT yet configurable through the `uart set` surface. Forward (Spec-first) development tracks the deferred surface explicitly so callers know the boundary; full-surface expansion of every Uart.xdm field is a separate, larger effort (issue #44). The deferred fields below DO exist in Uart.xdm and are currently emitted at byte-faithful fixture defaults by the apply builders -- they are not absent, just not user-tunable yet.

lpuart_channel: DesireBaudrate (16 standard/CUSTOM baud rates; validated against DesireBaudrate enum domain)
UartWordLength (7/8/9/10 bits; validated against UartWordLength enum domain)
UartParityType (disabled/even/odd; validated against UartParityType enum domain)
UartStopBitNumber (1/2 stop bits; validated against UartStopBitNumber enum domain)
UartClockRef -> Mcu clock reference point (derived from instance_irq_clock_map)
flexio_channel: DesireBaudrate (FlexIO 16 baud rates; validated against FlexioDesireBaudrate enum domain)
cross_module_orchestration: Platform ISR insertion (LPUART + DMATCD ISRs, grounded in uart.json + dma_hw_channel_irq_map)
Mcu clock reference point insertion (grounded in uart.json instance_irq_clock_map)
Mcl DMA logic channel insertion (dmaLogicChannel_Type_0 for TX, _Type_1 for RX; grounded in mcl_dma_channel_template)

not_yet_exposed._note: Each item is a Uart.xdm editable field currently fixed at a byte-faithful fixture default. Exposing any of these is future scope.
dma_channel: dmaLogicChannel full field set beyond the activation template (EnableTransferConfig, ScatterGather, transfer descriptors, source/destination addresses, TCD sizing, loop counts)

unconfirmed_from_xdm._note: Uart.xdm contains ~31 constraint rules and ~11 numeric vars NOT yet fully extracted from Uart.xdm -- these are marked as unconfirmed. The 14 enum domains currently tracked in this asset (UartWordLength, UartParityType, UartStopBitNumber, UartInteruptDmaMethod, DesireBaudrate, FlexioUartInteruptDmaMethod, FlexioDesireBaudrate, FlexioBitCount, FlexioDriverDirection, FlexioCustomTimerDecrement, UartTimeoutMethod, UartHwUsing, UartImplementationConfigVariant, and the CLI maps) represent the fully validated subset verified against both Uart.xdm and the fixture.

constraints._note: Extracted from Uart.xdm (RTD 7.0.1). The CLI enforces a subset; remaining constraints are caught by the S32DS vendor gate.

enforced_by_cli.uart_interrupt_dma_method: LPUART_UART_IP_USING_DMA / FLEXIO_UART_IP_DRIVER_TYPE_DMA require UartDmaEnable=true + populated Tx/Rx DMA channel refs + MCL DMA channels + Platform DMATCD ISRs
enforced_by_cli.lpuart_baud_validation: DesireBaudrate validated against DesireBaudrate enum domain
enforced_by_cli.flexio_baud_validation: FlexioDesireBaudrate validated against FlexioDesireBaudrate enum domain

vendor_gate_only.custom_baudrate_computation: LPUART: CustomBaudrateValue must match ClockFreq/(Mantissa*Divisor) when DesireBaudrate=CUSTOM
vendor_gate_only.flexio_custom_baudrate_computation: FlexIO: CustomBaudrateValue must match ClockFreq/(TimerDecrementFactor*Divider) when DesireBaudrate=CUSTOM
vendor_gate_only.hw_channel_uniqueness: UartHwChannel must be unique across all Uart channels; must not conflict with Lin driver
vendor_gate_only.flexio_hw_channel_ref_uniqueness: UartHwChannelRef must be unique across all FlexIO Uart channels
vendor_gate_only.uart_channel_id_uniqueness: UartChannelId must be unique and match positional index
vendor_gate_only.timeout_method_coherence: OSIF_COUNTER_CUSTOM requires OsIfUseCustomTimer=true; OSIF_COUNTER_SYSTEM requires OsIfUseSystemTimer=true
vendor_gate_only.ecuc_partition_coherence: UartMultipartitionSupport gates EcucPartitionRef validity and required count
vendor_gate_only.dma_ref_validity: UartDmaTxChannelRef/UartDmaRxChannelRef must be non-empty and valid when DMA selected
vendor_gate_only.flexio_dma_ref_validity: FlexioDmaChannelRef must be non-empty and valid when FlexIO DMA selected
vendor_gate_only.callback_coherence: UartCallbackCapability=true requires at least one UartCallback; UartCallback editable only when capability enabled

flexio_channel_template._note: Grounded in installed-RTD-derived FlexioModuleConfiguration field set (fixture-verified) and fixture lines 893-925 (Flexio0_Tx channel struct) and 926-958 (Flexio1_Rx channel struct). Field order is byte-faithful to the fixture.

dma_hw_channel_irq_map._note: Grounded in installed-RTD-derived sources: Platform.epd DMATCD IRQ table and Dma_Ip_Irq.c Dma0_Ch<N>_IRQHandler (S32K3 RTD 7.0.1, S32K344). NOT derived from the committed fixture (Uart_Example_S32K344). Mapping: DMA HW channel N -> DMATCD<N>_IRQn / Dma0_Ch<N>_IRQHandler. DMA TX uses ch 0 (existing fixture dmaLogicChannel_Type_0 HwChId=DMA_IP_HW_CH_0). DMA RX uses ch 1 (new dmaLogicChannel_Type_1 HwChId=DMA_IP_HW_CH_1). Cross-cutting fact also recorded in docs/specs/rtd-config-domain-truth.md §4.

mcl_dma_channel_template._note: Field set for activating a DMA logic channel. Grounded in fixture dmaLogicChannel_Type_0 (lines ~591-674 Uart_Example.mex). EnableGlobalConfig=true allows channel use. dmaGlobalRequest_enDmaRequest=true lets LPUART HW DMA request trigger transfer. dmaLogicChannelConfig_enDmaMajorInterrupt=true generates the DMATCD IRQ on transfer complete.

instance_irq_clock_map._note: Grounded in: S32K344_IRQ.h (IRQn/handler names), Platform.xdm/.epd ISR table, Uart.xdm UartClockRef domain, fixture Uart_Example_S32K344 clock tool. LPUART_0 and LPUART_8 use AIPS_PLAT_CLK; all others (LPUART_1..7, LPUART_9..15) use AIPS_SLOW_CLK. FLEXIO uses FLEXIO_CLK -> CORE_CLK (shared MCL_FLEXIO_ISR).
